node.statement: Right inverses from the defining axioms: for every A in calU, A^dagger bold-dot A=J and 1=||J||>= (1-epsilon_r)||A||^2, so epsilon_r<=1/64 gives ||A||=||A^dagger||<2. For every Y, comparing (A^dagger bold-dot A) bold-dot Y=Y with A^dagger bold-dot(A bold-dot Y), then using the associator and product-norm axioms, gives ||A bold-dot Y||>=(1/3)||Y||. Thus L_A is injective, hence bijective in finite dimension, with ||L_A^{-1}||<=3. In particular U^dagger has right inverse U. Also ||L_{U bold-dot V}-(L_U composed with L_V)||<=epsilon_r||U||||V||<=4*epsilon_r, whereas ||L_U L_V Y||>=(1/9)||Y||; since 1/9-4/64=7/144>0, L_{U bold-dot V} is injective and hence bijective, so U bold-dot V has a right inverse.
